text_block_list.text:
Gold City had to leave for her modeling 
job soon. While we were chatting before 
then...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, do you mind if I sit on the bench 
for a bit? I'm still listening.
choice_data_list: Are you tired, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Pretty much. So let me rest while I can. 
If my manager catches me staggering 
around, she'll nag my ear off."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't worry, I'll do just fine. 
*sigh*... Honestly though, I really just 
wanna slack off...

It seems she's accumulated quite a lot of 
fatigue. Perhaps I should reconsider our 
upcoming race schedule...
